I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**, their Director of Yard Operations.

That comes from Dana's own message in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, and Marcus is in that channel. She said Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift: one trailer showed up as two rows at 06:30 after a kiosk check-in plus a manual entry by dispatch. Dana owns the account, so I suggested Marcus check with her for the latest.

**Something went wrong:** my wrap-up note from Dana's request (ts 1791986400.000127) ended up in #north-team as a separate top-level message. It doesn't contain anything the channel can't already see, but it's clutter and shouldn't be there. I don't have a tool to delete messages, so someone would need to remove it by hand if you want it gone.
